name: double_half_hitch
title: Double half hitch
about: Two half hitches side by side on a holding cord, both turned the same way: the knot that draws lines and shapes in macrame, and the sailor's clove hitch. Shown loose, from the front.

steps.caption: Lay the holding cord straight across. Nothing else is tied yet.
Bring the working cord up over the holding cord, bend it over to the right, and take it down under the holding cord.
Carry the working cord across to the left, over its own standing part: that is one half hitch.
Take the working cord up over the holding cord again, to the left of the first hitch, and down under it.
Take the working cord straight down, over its own crossing part: the second half hitch, and both hitches sit side by side.
